공부.x: I study Korean at the library.
공부.e: Sino-Korean, but the parts don't add up to 'study' — just learn it whole. 공부하다 = to study.
공부.t: Both 한국어를 공부해요 and 한국어 공부를 해요 are natural.

동전.x: I have a lot of coins in my pocket.

독감.ex: 겨울이 되기 전에 독감 예방 주사를 맞았어요.
독감.x: I got a flu shot before winter came.
독감.e: Literally 'poisonous cold': a really bad cold, the flu.

입원.ex: 할머니는 입원 기간 동안 많이 좋아지셨어요.
입원.x: My grandmother got much better during her hospital stay.
입원.e: Literally 'entering the institution'; -원 = institution: 병원, 학원.

녹다.ex: 봄이 되면 산에 있는 눈이 녹아요.
녹다.x: When spring comes, the snow on the mountains melts.
녹다.e: Add -이- to make it transitive: 녹이다 'to melt something'.

깨닫다.forms: 깨달아요 · 깨달았어요 · 깨달을 거예요 · 깨달으세요 (ㄷ irregular)
깨닫다.m: to realize, to come to understand
깨닫다.x: Living abroad, I realized how precious my family is.
깨닫다.e: The ㄷ becomes ㄹ before vowels: 깨닫다 → 깨달아요, like 듣다 → 들어요.
깨닫다.t: Often used as -다는 것을 깨닫다: 'to realize that …'.

행운.ex: 내일 시험 잘 보세요. 행운을 빌어요!
행운.x: Good luck on your test tomorrow. Fingers crossed!
행운.t: 행운을 빌어요 is 'Good luck!'; casually, friends often just say 화이팅.

날카롭다.ex: 이 칼은 아주 날카로우니까 조심해서 쓰세요.
날카롭다.x: This knife is very sharp, so use it carefully.
날카롭다.e: From 날 (blade) + -카롭다; used for knives, eyes, remarks, and moods.
날카롭다.t: Also used for people: 날카로운 질문 (a sharp question) or 신경이 날카롭다 (to be on edge).

상표.ex: 옷에 붙어 있는 상표를 확인해 보세요.
상표.x: Check the label attached to the clothes.

자율 주행.ex: 자율 주행 자동차가 곧 도로를 달릴 거예요.
자율 주행.x: Self-driving cars will soon be on the roads.

비닐봉지.ex: 요즘 마트에서는 비닐봉지를 무료로 주지 않아요.
비닐봉지.x: These days supermarkets don't give out free plastic bags.
비닐봉지.t: Konglish alert: 비닐 means plastic film or bags, not just vinyl; 플라스틱 is for hard plastic.

탕.forms: 탕 + 하고 울리다 / 소리가 나다; 탕탕 (repeated)
탕.ex: 밖에서 갑자기 탕 하고 총소리가 났어요.
탕.x: Suddenly there was a bang of a gunshot outside.
탕.e: 의성어 (sound word) for a sharp bang, like a gunshot or a door slammed shut.
탕.t: Repeat it for several shots: 탕탕. Also used for slamming: 문을 탕 닫았어요.

무인 매장.ex: 집 앞 무인 매장에서 아이스크림을 샀어요.
무인 매장.x: I bought ice cream at the unstaffed store in front of my place.
무인 매장.t: Common types are ice-cream shops, laundromats and study cafés: you pay at a kiosk while CCTV keeps watch.

독점.ex: 한 회사가 시장을 독점하면 가격이 오를 수 있어요.
독점.x: If one company monopolizes the market, prices can go up.

중재.ex: 제3국의 중재로 두 나라가 대화를 다시 시작했습니다.
중재.x: Through a third country's mediation, the two nations resumed talks.

장기.ex: 그는 사고로 세상을 떠나며 장기를 기증했어요.
장기.x: He passed away in an accident and donated his organs.
장기.t: Homonym warning: 장기 also means long-term (長期) and a chess-like board game (將棋).

동반하다.m: to accompany, to go together with; to be accompanied by
동반하다.ex: 이번 태풍은 강한 비를 동반할 것으로 보입니다.
동반하다.x: This typhoon is expected to bring heavy rain.

식별하다.m: to identify, to make out, to distinguish
식별하다.x: The fog was so thick that it was hard to make out the car ahead.
식별하다.e: Literally 'know and separate' — recognizing what something is.
식별하다.t: 식별 is recognizing or identifying, often by sight; 판별 is judging which is right or real.

총괄하다.m: to oversee, to be in overall charge of
총괄하다.x: She is the manager overseeing this project.
총괄하다.e: Literally 'bundle everything together' — holding all the threads.

깡그리.ex: 화재로 집 안의 물건이 깡그리 타 버렸어요.
깡그리.x: Everything in the house burned up completely in the fire.

뭉클.m: with a lump in one's throat, deeply moved, touched
뭉클.ex: 아이의 첫 편지를 받고 가슴이 뭉클했어요.
뭉클.x: I was deeply moved when I got my child's first letter.
뭉클.e: A mimetic word for a soft lump; a lump in your chest means being moved.

목에 힘을 주다.forms: 목에 힘을 줘요 · 목에 힘을 줬어요 · 목에 힘주지 마세요
목에 힘을 주다.m: to act arrogant; to put on airs
목에 힘을 주다.ex: 승진하더니 그 사람이 목에 힘을 주고 다녀요.
목에 힘을 주다.x: Since his promotion, he's been strutting around putting on airs.
목에 힘을 주다.e: Literally 'to stiffen one's neck,' holding the head high in pride.

척도.ex: 성적이 사람을 평가하는 유일한 척도는 아니에요.
척도.x: Grades aren't the only yardstick for judging a person.
척도.e: Literally 'ruler and degree': a tool for measuring.

승려.ex: 산속 절에서 승려들이 아침 예불을 드리고 있었어요.
승려.x: The monks were holding morning prayers at the temple in the mountains.
승려.e: Literally 'monk companions', originally the community of monks.
승려.t: Pronounced [승녀] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ. In conversation, people say the respectful 스님 instead.

속셈.m: hidden intention, ulterior motive; mental arithmetic
속셈.ex: 그가 갑자기 친절한 데는 다른 속셈이 있는 것 같아요.
속셈.x: I think he has an ulterior motive for suddenly being so kind.
속셈.e: 속 'inside' + 셈 'calculation': the calculation you keep inside.
속셈.t: Pronounced [속쎔]; 무슨 속셈이야? is a common suspicious question: 'What are you up to?'

비아냥.x: There was sarcasm mixed into his words.
비아냥.e: Noun form of 비아냥거리다 'to sneer'; the same root gives 비아냥대다.
비아냥.t: Often in 비아냥을 듣다, 'to get sneered at'.

도전장.ex: 신생 기업이 업계 1위 회사에 도전장을 내밀었습니다.
도전장.x: A startup has thrown down the gauntlet to the industry's top company.
도전장.t: Pronounced [도전짱]; 도전장을 내밀다 means 'to throw down the gauntlet'.

가처분소득.ex: 세금과 이자가 늘면서 가계의 가처분소득이 줄었습니다.
가처분소득.x: As taxes and interest rose, household disposable income fell.
가처분소득.e: Literally 'income that can be disposed of': what remains after taxes.
가처분소득.t: Not to be confused with legal 가처분 'injunction'; 가처분소득 is always about income.

후험적.ex: 경험을 통해 얻는 지식을 후험적 지식이라고 해요.
후험적.x: Knowledge gained through experience is called a posteriori knowledge.
후험적.e: Literally 'after-experience', the mirror image of 선험적.
후험적.t: Outside philosophy, 경험적 (empirical) is far more common than 후험적.

응용과학.x: Engineering and medicine are typical fields of applied science.

명료하다.x: His explanation was short but clear.
명료하다.t: Pronounced [명뇨하다] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ.

아리송하다.ex: 그 사람 말이 사실인지 아직도 아리송해요.
아리송하다.x: I'm still not sure whether what he said is true.
아리송하다.e: Related to the livelier form 알쏭달쏭하다, which also means 'puzzling, hard to pin down'.

방불하다.forms: 방불해요 · 방불했어요 · 방불한 (+noun); usually: ~을 방불케 하다
방불하다.m: to closely resemble, to be reminiscent of
방불하다.ex: 오늘 경기장 분위기는 결승전을 방불케 했습니다.
방불하다.x: The stadium atmosphere today was like a final.
방불하다.e: Both syllables mean 'resembling'; an old pair for 'looking just like'.
방불하다.t: Almost always in the pattern A를 방불케 하다 (to make one think of A).

과잉유동성.x: As low interest rates continued, the problem of excess liquidity grew.
과잉유동성.e: Literally 'too much flowing money' in the economy.
과잉유동성.t: Common in economic news alongside 자산 거품 'asset bubbles.'

백혈구.x: White blood cells protect the body from bacteria.
백혈구.t: Pronounced [배켤구]: ㄱ + ㅎ merge into ㅋ.
